item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the easterly airstream, it will be humid in the morning and at night and warm during the day over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week to early next week. There will be occasional showers and isolated thunderstorms over the region. The northeast monsoon will bring a few rain patches to southern China midweek next week and temperatures will fall slightly.
